findings.detail: Seventeen selected SR 26-2, SR 11-7, NIST AI RMF and Playbook units resolve with exact source, unit and fidelity hashes.
Eight substantive sections across the proposed note and question have one exact reviewed evidence binding.
The evidence supports scoped supervisory guidance and voluntary framework expectations; no universal legal obligation is asserted.
SR 26-2 and SR 11-7 retain their banking supervisory scope; NIST AI RMF remains voluntary.
